remarks: **Public Remarks:**  **Public Remarks:**  Welcome to this stunning 2-bedroom, 2-full bath townhouse featuring beautiful hardwood floors throughout. The first level boasts a nice flow, seamlessly connecting the living room, dining room, and kitchen, perfect for entertaining and everyday living. Enjoy the comfort of central air and the efficiency of natural gas heat-an ideal utility setup. The spacious finished basement offers the perfect space for a home office or bonus room. Enjoy the outdoors on your private deck and take advantage of the 2 reserved parking spaces, along with ample visitor parking. Centrally located, this home is just minutes from downtown Stamford, with easy access to shopping, restaurants, groceries, and convenience stores. Golf enthusiasts will love being across the street from E. Gaynoor Brennan Golf Course, and Scalzi Park is just down the street. Commuters will appreciate the unbeatable convenience, situated right between I-95 and the Merritt Parkway. This townhouse offers the perfect blend of comfort, convenience, and location. Don't miss out on this incredible opportunity!
